Perfect! Now let me compile a comprehensive report of my findings. ## Complete Widget Implementation Analysis I've thoroughly explored the storefront widget implementation. Here's what I found: --- ### 1. **App Embed Block** (`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/app-embed.liquid`) This is a simple app embed block (target: body) that **sets the global flag**: ```liquid ``` This flag is checked by the main widget block to determine if the app is active. It's a schema-only embed with no configuration. --- ### 2. **Main Widget Block HTML Structure** (`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid`) #### **Design Mode (Theme Editor Preview)** - Shows inactive state by default (gray box with "Enable app embed" message) - Shows active state when `window.__zccAppEnabled` is true - Active preview displays a mock widget with form, input, and a success result message - Polls for `window.__zccAppEnabled` at 500ms, 1.5s, 3s intervals #### **Live Mode (Storefront)** Has a root container: ```html
``` The widget tries to: 1. Load config from embedded metafield (instant, no network) 2. Fallback to API call to `/api/widget-config?shop=...` if needed 3. Render one of 3 positions based on config --- ### 3. **CSS Architecture & Scoping** #### **Global CSS Injection** The `injectCss()` function (lines 246-301 in zip-code-checker.liquid) **injects CSS globally into ``** with NO scoping: ```javascript function injectCss(wid, cfg, rad) { var css = "#" + wid + "{...}" + // Scoped by ID (#zcc-widget-...) "#" + wid + " *{box-sizing:border-box !important}" + "#" + wid + " .zcc-heading{...}" + // ... more class-based selectors ; var styleEl = document.createElement("style"); styleEl.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(styleEl); // ← GLOBAL, not scoped } ``` **All rules use `!important`** to force override theme styles. #### **CSS Class Names Used** All prefixed with `.zcc-`: - `.zcc-heading` — widget title - `.zcc-row` — flex container (input + button) - `.zcc-input` — text input field - `.zcc-btn` — check button - `.zcc-result` — result container - `.zcc-result.ok` — success state (green background) - `.zcc-result.fail` — failure state (red background) - `.zcc-meta` — metadata lines (eta, zone, days) - `.zcc-cutoff` — order cutoff time - `.zcc-days` — delivery days - `.zcc-cod` — cash on delivery indicator - `.zcc-cod--available` / `--unavailable` — COD states - `.zcc-return-policy` — return policy text - `.zcc-social-proof` — "Join X others waiting" message - `.zcc-wl` — waitlist section container - `.zcc-wl-input` — waitlist email/name inputs - `.zcc-wl-btn` — waitlist submit button - `.zcc-wl-toggle` — link to expand waitlist form (inline) **Floating position adds:** - `.zcc-hidden` — visibility toggle for panel - `.zcc-panel-header` — floating window header - `.zcc-panel-close` — close button in header **Popup position adds:** - `.zcc-open` — overlay visibility toggle #### **Custom CSS Handling** Line 309 in zip-code-checker.liquid: ```javascript (cfg.customCss ? cfg.customCss.replace(/<\/style>/gi, "") : "") ``` Custom CSS is appended directly. **It's NOT scoped**—merchants can add any global styles. **Only `` tags are stripped** to prevent breaking out of the injected `` stripped) - Multiple widgets on same page share CSS class namespace (`.zcc-*`) but are ID-scoped **Potential Conflicts:** 1. If two shops' widgets load on same page, `.zcc-` classes collide but `#zcc-widget-BLOCK_ID` IDs prevent styling conflicts 2. Theme CSS with `.zcc-` prefixes would be overridden 3.
